_note: Sleeper leagues tracked by the site. default=true is selected first. my_roster_id is your team; viewers are the teams the Team picker offers (add your brother's or anyone's roster_id here). Yahoo leagues: provider=yahoo, yahoo_league_id, viewer_team = the team name to view as; yahoo_account = whose Yahoo sign-in reads it (each person connects once); teams / my_roster_id / viewers are filled from the Yahoo snapshot (data/site/leagues.json).
